name: raycast-mise
title: Mise Dev Environment
description: Manage mise tools, tasks, environment variables, settings, daemons and trust for each of your projects
author: hasansezertasan

commands.name: tools
commands.title: Manage Tools
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: See the tools of a project, including missing ones, and install, use, upgrade, remove or uninstall them

commands.name: use-tool
commands.title: Use Tool
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Search the mise registry and add a tool version to a project or your global config

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Run Task
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Search the tasks of a project and run them, with arguments, in watch mode or forced

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Create a TOML task or a file task in a project

commands.name: env-vars
commands.title: Show Environment Variables
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: See the environment variables mise sets for a project, where each comes from, and set new ones

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Manage Settings
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: See every mise setting with its effective value and change or reset it

commands.name: projects
commands.title: Manage Projects
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Choose and add projects, review and trust config files, and run install, fmt, lock, bootstrap and project checks

commands.name: daemons
commands.title: Manage Daemons
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Start, stop and restart the daemons of a project, follow their logs and open them in the browser

commands.name: doctor
commands.title: Run Doctor
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Show the output of mise doctor for a project

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Mise Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Show missing tools and daemon status of the current project in the menu bar

preferences.name: misePath
preferences.title: Mise Executable Path
preferences.description: Path to the mise executable. Leave empty to find it automatically.

preferences.name: miseEnv
preferences.title: Mise Environment
preferences.description: The MISE_ENV profile, e.g. staging, so that mise also loads mise.staging.toml. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for none.

preferences.name: showEnvValues
preferences.title: Environment Variables
preferences.label: Show values by default
preferences.description: Show environment variable values without revealing them one by one. Values can contain secrets.

preferences.name: trustOwnEdits
preferences.title: Paranoid Mode
preferences.label: Trust config files again after editing them here
preferences.description: In mise paranoid mode, changing a project setting from this extension makes mise stop trusting the config file. When on, a file that was trusted before the change is trusted again.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
